_note: Illustrative approximation of real program structure for a hackathon demo. Figures are synthetic and must not be relied on operationally.
_coverageNote: Percentage of Income Payment Plans exist in some states and not others. CA and TX are deliberately absent — that absence is part of the demo.

programs.name: Illinois Percentage of Income Payment Plan
programs.citation: Illinois PIPP administered by DCEO under the LIHEAP state plan
programs.administeredBy: Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity

intakeVia.name: Community and Economic Development Association of Cook County (CEDA)

criteria.text: Household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level.
Account carries at least $250 in arrears.
Enrolment is capped and closes when funding is exhausted.

incomeCap.text: The customer's monthly electricity payment is capped at 6% of gross monthly household income, with a $30 minimum.

programs.name: New York Energy Affordability Program discount
programs.citation: NYPSC Energy Affordability Program — bill discount component

criteria.text: Household received a HEAP benefit in the current program year.

incomeCap.text: Energy burden is targeted at 6% of household income through a tiered monthly bill discount.
